title: Contracting a supplied split identity summand
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and C,C′,T chain complexes of R-modules. Fix i∈Z and assume T_j is subsingleton outside i,i-1. Supply linear equivalences e:T_i≅R and f:T_{i-1}≅R with f(d_T t)=e(t). Supply linear equivalences ψ_j:C′_j⊕T_j≅C_j for the Bool-indexed direct sum [def-weil-pbc-direct-sum-modules] satisfying d_C ψ_j(x,t)=ψ_{j-1}(d_{C′}x,d_Tt). Then C and C′ are homotopy equivalent [def-pc-derived-category]. No bases, ranks, unit coefficients, or affine schemes are assumed.

source.place: Tag 00MT (lemma-add-trivial-complex), two-term identity summand; its elementary contraction, read https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00MT; step 3 of lem-pc-affine-free-complex-unit-cancellation

proof.text: Identify the binary direct sum with the product by its two component maps. Through ψ define the complementary projection π and inclusion ι, and the T projection π_T and inclusion ι_T. Differential compatibility gives all four chain-map equations. Componentwise linear algebra proves ιπ=id_C′ and πι+π_Tι_T=id_C.

The map s=e^{-1}f from T_{i-1} to T_i is inverse to its differential: applying e or f reduces either identity to f(d_Tt)=e(t). Set h(j,k)=s for (j,k)=(i-1,i), transported along index equalities, and zero otherwise. Its homotopy equation id_T=d h+h d holds at i and i-1 by these inverse identities. In all other degrees equality of maps follows from the subsingleton codomain. Thus id_T is homotopic to zero.

Compose the T contraction with π_T and ι_T to get π_Tι_T homotopic to zero. Add the reflexive homotopy of πι. Using πι+π_Tι_T=id_C gives id_C homotopic to πι; reverse it. Together with ιπ=id_C′ this constructs the desired homotopy equivalence.

lean.statement: theorem nonempty_homotopyEquiv_of_split_identity {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (C C' T : ChainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (i : ℤ) (hT : ∀ j : ℤ, j ≠ i → j ≠ i - 1 → Subsingleton (T.X j)) (e : T.X i ≃ₗ[R] R) (f : T.X (i - 1) ≃ₗ[R] R) (hef : ∀ t : T.X i, f ((T.d i (i - 1)).hom t) = e t) : let M : ℤ → Bool → ModuleCat.{u} R := fun j s ↦ if s then T.X j else C'.X j ∀ (ψ : ∀ j : ℤ, (⨁ s : Bool, M j s) ≃ₗ[R] C.X j) (_hψ : ∀ (j : ℤ) (x : C'.X j) (t : T.X j), (C.d j (j - 1)).hom (ψ j (DirectSum.lof R Bool (fun s ↦ M j s) false x + DirectSum.lof R Bool (fun s ↦ M j s) true t)) = ψ (j - 1) (DirectSum.lof R Bool (fun s ↦ M (j - 1) s) false ((C'.d j (j - 1)).hom x) + DirectSum.lof R Bool (fun s ↦ M (j - 1) s) true ((T.d j (j - 1)).hom t))), Nonempty (HomotopyEquiv C C')
